name: 85901 · Show Low, AZ
findings: ZIP 85901 (Show Low) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85901 (Show Low) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
